Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.messenger

Class ChatMessage

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.messenger.ChatMessage
public final class ChatMessage extends Object
An immutable, protocol-neutral chat event delivered by a MessengerProtocol to its ProtocolListener. Every backend (the native IRC client, or any future plugin) normalises its wire traffic into this one value type, so the UI never has to know which protocol a message came from.

from is the sender's display identity (an IRC nick, a JID, a phone number) or null for server/system events. target is the conversation the event belongs to (a channel such as #lg3d or a peer nick). text is the already-decoded, display-ready body.
